algorithm: {\text{For each bin, calculate the remaining space after adding the given item; assign a priority equal to the negative of this remaining space if the bin can fit the item, otherwise assign negative infinity to represent an invalid bin.}
function:
def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    mask = bins >= item
    return np.where(mask, -(bins - item), -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    scores[valid_mask] = -(bins[valid_mask] - item)
    return scores
